newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Amtek in S$22 mln metal parts project.
newsitem.headline: Amtek in S$22 mln metal parts project.

text.p: Amtek Engineering Ltd said on Friday it was investing Singapore S$22 million to make delicate metal parts in Singapore using a technology licensed from a Japanese firm.
"Total investments in this project will amount to S$22 million," including a factory it bought last March for S$3.88 million, Amtek said in a statement.

Amtek said it would pay Japan's Syvec Corporation 120 million yen for exclusive rights to its Cold Forging Progressive Stamping (CFPS) technology in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Philippines.
